prompts.prompt: Refactor the legacy Flask Sudoku application into a modular architecture while preserving all existing functionality.
Add Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels that generate puzzles with different numbers of prefilled cells.
Ensure every generated Sudoku puzzle has exactly one valid solution.
Add a timer that starts with a new game, updates continuously, and stops when the puzzle is solved.
Implement a Hint button that fills one correct cell, locks it, tracks hints used, and highlights the hinted cell.
Add a Check Puzzle button that compares the current board with the solution and highlights incorrect cells.
Display a congratulatory message when the puzzle is completed, showing the completion time and hints used.
Create a Top 10 leaderboard that stores the player's name, completion time, difficulty level, and hints used.
Persist the leaderboard using browser Local Storage and load saved scores automatically.
Add a Dark Mode toggle while maintaining readability and accessibility.
Improve the layout so it works well on desktop and mobile devices with alternating colors for each 3×3 Sudoku section.
